proc.label: Production processes in the installation
proc.help: Define each production process (e.g. sinter plant, blast furnace, steel plant, rolling mill) and the goods it produces. The same CN code can be the output of only one process. If the precursors produced in the installation are not sold, you can define one joint process ('bubble').
proc.eNone: Enter at least one production process.
proc.eJointMin: {{label}}: a joint process must cover at least 2 categories.
proc.eJointNoSale: {{label}}: a joint process is allowed only if no precursor produced within the process is sold or transferred.
proc.eRoute: {{label}}: select a production route for the category “{{category}}”.
proc.eMethodMb: {{label}}: the mass balance method is mandatory for this category.
proc.eNoOutput: {{label}}: enter at least one product (output) of the process.
proc.eActivity: {{label}}: the activity level (sum of produced quantities) must be greater than 0.
proc.eHydrogen: {{what}}: hydrogen (2804 10 00) is not a good of the iron and steel sector.
proc.eOutputCategory: {{what}}: CN {{cn}} belongs to the category “{{category}}”, which this process does not cover.
proc.eCnMulti: CN {{cn}} is the output of several processes ({{processes}}). The same CN code can be the output of only one process.
proc.wNoProcess: The declared product {{cn}} is not the output of any process – the default value will be used for it.
proc.name: Process name
proc.noSaleConfirm: No precursor produced within this process is sold or transferred
proc.mbForced: For this category the carbon in the product, slag and waste is accounted for with the mass balance method – the method is mandatory.
proc.outputsTitle: Process outputs (activity level in the reporting period, t)
proc.outputsHelp: Quantity produced in the reporting period (sold or used as a precursor in another process), excluding waste, off-spec products, by-products and residues.
proc.deleteInfo: Deleting a process also deletes all its rows in the following steps (fuels, mass balance, energy flows, electricity, precursors, parameters).

de.fuelHelp: Enter the fuel consumed in the process. Fuel used to produce heat that is used in several processes is not entered here but as heat (Energy flows step). Enter waste gases imported from another process in the Energy flows step.
de.matHelp: Method A: input carbonate (e.g. limestone CaCO3). Method B: output oxide (e.g. CaO in lime/slag). Share = mass fraction of pure carbonate/oxide in the material.
de.mbHelp: Enter all carbon-containing inputs (fuels, reducing agents, scrap, alloys, electrodes, additives, purchased precursors) and outputs (product, slag, dust). Outputs are subtracted. Do not enter waste gas as an output – its export is entered in the Energy flows step. CO in unpurified waste gas is counted as CO2.
de.eNcvNm3: {{what}}: for the unit 1000 Nm³ enter an NCV (GJ/1000 Nm³) > 0.
de.wBiomass: {{what}}: biomass fraction > 0 – the biomass sustainability criteria are not checked.
de.wWgInFuel: {{what}}: waste gas entered as a fuel – check that imported waste gas is not counted twice.
de.wEfNcvDev: {{what}}: the entered EF/NCV deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value.
de.wEfDevEntered: {{what}}: the entered EF deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value.
de.eMbMaterial: {{what}}: select a material or enter a name.
de.wCcDev: {{what}}: the carbon content deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value.
de.wEfDev: {{what}}: the EF deviates by more than 50 % from the standard value.
de.wMbNoOutput: Process {{id}}: the mass balance has no outputs (carbon in the product/slag is not accounted for).
de.name: Name
de.title: Direct emissions per process
de.titleHelp: Only the tables that match the method selected for each process are shown. Standard values (Annex II G of Regulation 2025/2547) are filled in automatically and can be changed.
de.factorsError: Standard factors were not loaded ({{error}}) – enter the values manually or select “Other”.
de.dropped: {{count}} saved rows do not match the method or an existing process and will be removed when saving.

ef.heatLabel: Measurable heat (import into / export from the process)
ef.heatHelp: Net measurable heat (steam, hot water) in TJ. Heat from exothermic chemical processes and heat recovered from electricity-driven processes has zero emissions.
ef.wgLabel: Waste gases (BFG, BOFG, coke oven gas) – import/export
ef.wgHelp: Import: gas produced in another process and combusted in this one. Export: gas produced in this process and combusted in another (e.g. a power plant). Gases produced and consumed in the same process are not entered here.
ef.elLabel: Electricity produced within the process boundaries
ef.elHelp: Only if electricity is produced from fuels included in this process (Emel,prod in equation 55). EF according to equation 38; for waste gas at most the EF of natural gas is used.
ef.wNoEvidence: {{what}}: without evidence the supplier EF is not used – the standard fuel EF / 0.9 applies.
ef.eFuelForStdNoEvidence: {{what}}: select the fuel for the standard EF (used when there is no evidence).
ef.wWgCap: {{what}}: the mix contains waste gas – for waste gas at most the EF of natural gas (56.1 t CO2/TJ) may be used.
ef.eFuelForStd: {{what}}: select the fuel for the standard EF.
ef.wWgExport: {{what}}: waste gas export without evidence for the verifier – the deduction is not applied.
ef.evidence: Evidence for the verifier is available
ef.mixHasWg: The fuel mix contains waste gas
ef.chpEmField: Emissions of the CHP unit (t CO2)
ef.chpQField: Net heat produced by the CHP (TJ)
ef.wgCapNote: If waste gas is part of the fuel mix and its EF is above 56.1 t CO2/TJ, use 56.1 t CO2/TJ for the waste gas.
ef.title: Energy flows
ef.titleHelp: All entries in this step are optional. Enter only heat and waste gas flows that cross the process boundaries.

el.label: Electricity consumption – only for agglomerated ore (sinter/pellets)
el.help: Indirect emissions are counted only for CN 2601 12 00. For a joint process enter only the consumption of the sinter/pellet plant. If electricity comes from several sources, enter the shares of the sources (weighted average, Art. 9 of Regulation 2025/2547).
el.eMissing: Process {{id}}: an agglomerated ore process must have electricity consumption.
el.wNoEvidence: {{what}}: without evidence the default grid emission factor is used.
el.notNeeded: This step is not needed for your processes.
el.ignored: Previously entered rows ({{count}}) are not used and will be removed.
el.fallback: – country not in the table, “Other countries and territories” is used

rp.label: Additional reporting parameters (iron and steel sector)
rp.help: The parameters are passed to the importer for the CBAM declaration (Annex IV point 2 of Regulation 2025/2547).
rp.none: There are no additional parameters for this category.

cn.eLenShort: {{what}}: the CN code must have 4, 6 or 8 digits.
cn.eLen8: {{what}}: the CN code must have 4 to 8 digits (e.g. 7208 or 7208 51 20).
cn.tooShort: {{what}} ({{cn}}): the default values (Annex I to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621) differ below this code. Pick a more precise code from the list.
cn.excluded: the code is explicitly excluded from CBAM (e.g. ferro-silicon, waste and scrap 7204).
cn.notSteel: the code is not a CBAM good of the iron and steel sector.

pre.label: Precursors (input materials that are CBAM goods)
pre.help: The mass includes the part that is cut off, burnt or becomes scrap (mi includes scrap). Precursors from the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland have zero emissions. Actual supplier values may be used only with a verification report; otherwise the default value is used.
pre.eSource: {{what}}: select the process the precursor comes from.
pre.eSelf: {{what}}: a process cannot be its own precursor.
pre.eNoSource: {{what}}: the source process {{id}} does not exist.
pre.eJoint: {{what}}: a precursor cannot come from a joint process ('bubble').
pre.wNotOutput: {{what}}: CN {{cn}} is not an output of process {{id}}.
pre.eCountry: {{what}}: select the country of origin or mark it as unknown.
pre.eActual: {{what}}: enter the actual specific direct emissions of the supplier.
pre.wUnverified: {{what}}: the actual data are not verified – the default value will be used.
pre.eYear: {{what}}: the production year must have four digits.
pre.wYear: {{what}}: for years before 2026 the default value for 2026 is used.
pre.wUnusual: {{what}}: the category “{{category}}” is not a usual precursor for {{process}}.
pre.wMi: Process {{id}}: the precursor mass per tonne of product is {{m}} < 1 – check that cut-off scrap is included.
pre.internal: From another process of this installation
pre.cn8Default: Code must be precise enough for the default value
pre.countryUnknown: The country of production is not known
pre.zeroEu: Precursor originating in the EU – embedded emissions are counted as zero.
pre.zeroExempt: Precursor from a country/territory exempt from CBAM – embedded emissions are counted as zero.
pre.seeIndirectHelp: Only the carried-over indirect emissions of sintered ore.
pre.verified: The data are verified by an accredited verifier
pre.jointNote: Precursors produced within a joint process are not entered as precursors.

pd.eHydrogen: {{what}}: hydrogen (2804 10 00) can be entered only as a precursor, not as declared goods.
pd.eQty: {{what}}: the quantity (t) must be greater than 0.
pd.wEu: {{what}}: goods originating in an EU Member State – embedded emissions are not calculated (result 0).
pd.wExempt: {{what}}: goods originating in a country exempt from CBAM – result 0.

general.yearLabel: Year of import of the goods into the EU

general.installationHelp: Installation from Settings where the goods were produced.

pd.title: Product details – cement
pd.intro: Enter each imported product: CN code (one of the 6 cement codes of Annex I to Regulation 2023/956), TARIC where required, quantity in tonnes of good, country of origin and the clinker content for cement.
pd.name: Product name
pd.ckActualInfo: The clinker content is required for cement (2523 21 00, 2523 29 00, 2523 90 00) when you calculate with actual data (functional unit: t clinker contained, Art. 4(5) of Regulation 2025/2547).
pd.mappingError: CN codes could not be loaded: {{error}}
pd.dialogText: For clinker (2523 10 00), other hydraulic cements (2523 90 00) and calcined clay (2507 00 80) the default values depend on the TARIC subdivision (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740, recitals 5–6).
pd.whiteDefinition: White cement clinker (help for the choice, point 5.2.1 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2620): average contents of at most 0.4 mass-% Fe2O3, 0.003 mass-% Cr2O3 and 0.03 mass-% Mn2O3; all other clinker is grey.
pd.rangeRule: Cement in ranges of composition: ranges “shall not be larger than 10 %” (Annex III B of Regulation 2025/2547). Enter the clinker content of the consignment or range.

proc.label: Production processes in the installation
proc.help: Define each production process (e.g. clinker kiln, cement mill, clay calcination) and the goods leaving it. The same CN/TARIC code may leave only one process. If clinker (and calcined clay) produced in the installation is neither sold nor used in other processes, you may define one joint process ('bubble').
proc.name: Process name
proc.jointCategory: Output of the joint process: cement
proc.noSaleConfirm: I confirm that the clinker / calcined clay produced in the installation is neither sold nor used in other processes.
proc.jointHelp: A joint process must cover cement and at least one precursor category (Art. 4(9) of Regulation 2025/2547; Guidance 05a p. 26). White and grey cement in one process are allowed (open question OQ-CE-1); separate processes are recommended.
proc.outputsHelp: Quantity produced in the reporting period (t good). Only goods that can be sold or used directly as a precursor – not off-spec products, by-products or waste.
proc.alPreview: Activity level: {{fu}} t (functional unit) · {{mass}} t good
proc.deleteInfo: Deleting a process also deletes all its rows in the following steps.
proc.eJoint_categories: {{label}}: a joint process must cover cement and at least one of the categories clinker / calcined clay.
proc.eJoint_confirmation: {{label}}: a joint process is allowed only with the confirmation that the precursors are not sold.

de.title: Direct emissions
de.titleHelp: Enter the data per process. Calculate the clinker process emissions with Method A (input) or Method B (clinker output), never both for the same process.
de.fuelHelp: Enter all kiln fuels (conventional, alternative fossil, biomass/waste) and non-kiln fuels (drying, calciners). For waste fuels enter the biomass fraction. Fuel for heat used in more than one process is entered as heat (Energy flows step).
de.matHelp: Carbonates in raw materials or raw meal as a whole, non-carbonate carbon, carbonates for flue gas scrubbing, urea in de-NOx. Do not enter the raw material corresponding to discarded dust (CKD) here. Blank EF for a Table 3/4 code = standard value.
de.eEfOrCc: {{what}}: enter the EF or the carbon content.
de.rawMealRatioHelp: Site-specific empirical ratio, updated at least once a year (Annex II B.9.2.1).
de.cliLabel: Clinker process emissions – Method B (clinker output based)
de.cliHelp: Clinker quantity by direct weighing or by the cement-deliveries balance (Equation 27). Minimum requirement: emission factor 0.525 t CO2/t clinker (Annex II B.9.2.2 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2547).
de.efAnalysisHelp: Value from clinker analysis (recommended improvement). A correction for non-carbonate CaO/MgO is not calculated (open question OQ-CE-3).
de.eEfAnalysis: {{what}}: the EF from analysis must be > 0.
de.balanceTitle: Balance: Cli = Σ (Cem_deliv − Cem_SV) × CCR − Cli_s + Cli_d − Cli_SV
de.balanceHelp: Formula as printed (Equation 27, Annex II B.9.2.2). The sign of the stock variations is not defined by the sources; interpretation “variation = opening − closing stock” (open question OQ-CE-2). Blank fields are sent as 0.
de.ckdLabel: Discarded cement kiln dust (CKD) / bypass dust
de.ckdHelp: Only dust leaving the kiln system. Do not enter the raw material corresponding to this dust as a Method A input.
de.dHelp: Entered in %, used as d/100 (open question OQ-CE-15).
de.ckdPreview: Preview: EF_CKD = {{ef}} t CO2/t → {{em}} t CO2

ef.title: Energy flows
ef.titleHelp: Measurable heat imported into or exported from the process (e.g. kiln heat exported to district heating) and electricity produced in the process.
ef.heatHelp: Net heat in TJ. Export, e.g. kiln heat exported to district heating, is subtracted from the process emissions.
ef.elHelp: Emissions of electricity produced in the process are subtracted from the direct emissions (Equation 55).

el.label: Electricity consumption per process
el.help: Indirect emissions are counted for all cement goods. Default grid factor: Annex II to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621. Actual factor only with a direct technical link or a power purchase agreement (PPA) and evidence. For a joint process enter the total consumption.
el.jointNote: Joint process: enter the total consumption without split.

pre.label: Precursors (clinker, calcined clay)
pre.help: Mass includes losses. Precursors from the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland have zero emissions. Gypsum, slag, fly ash and other additives are not precursors.
pre.notNeeded: This step is not needed for your processes.
pre.jointNote: Clinker produced inside the joint process is not entered; additionally purchased clinker is.
pre.annexIv: Annex IV – unknown country of production

res.perFu: SEE per functional unit (t clinker): dir. / indir. / total
res.fuNotApplicable: not applicable (default value or t good)
res.activity: · activity level {{fu}} t FU / {{mass}} t good
